# code-switched-en-sw-es.m4a

64.5 s, AAC 32 kbps, 16 kHz mono (the Index 01 ring's format). Synthesized with OpenAI
gpt-4o-mini-tts (voice coral), segments joined with 0.6 to 1.2 s pauses and pink noise at about
-48 dBFS. Segment 4 switches between English and Swahili inside one sentence.

1. [en] Okay, quick note for tomorrow. I need to call the landlord about the water heater before ten in the morning, because it has been broken since Sunday.
2. [sw] Halafu nikumbuke kununua mkate, maziwa na sukari sokoni jioni, kabla duka halijafungwa.
3. [en] Also, the meeting with Amina moved to Thursday afternoon, so I should tell the team.
4. [mixed] Tell Juma kwamba tutaonana kesho asubuhi at the office, near the main entrance.
5. [es] Y no olvides enviar el informe a Carlos antes del viernes por la tarde, porque lo necesita para la reunión.
6. [sw] Nimechoka sana leo, lakini kazi lazima iendelee. Mama alipiga simu asubuhi.
7. [es] La cena del sábado es en casa de Lucía, a las ocho.
8. [en] Finally, book the flight to Nairobi for the second week of November, and check the visa rules.
